title: The Adventure of the Cardboard Box
description: A gruesome mystery involving a cardboard box containing human ears sent to Miss Susan Shafaq. The investigation leads to a shocking crime of passion and betrayal aboard a ship.
intro_narrative: It was a blazing hot day in August when Kuldeep Ranbir received a peculiar letter regarding a gruesome package sent to Miss Susan Shafaq of Croydon. The package contained two human ears, sparking a mysterious investigation that would lead Ranbir and his assistant Tanushree through a web of deceit, secrets, and murder. As they delve deeper, they uncover a tale of jealousy, betrayal, and a sailor's vengeance.

required_evidence: Photograph of Kiran Shafaq with a steward
required_motive: Jealousy and revenge for his wife's infidelity and his sister-in-law's meddling

phases.name: Initial Investigation
phases.objective: Examine the cardboard box and its contents at Miss Susan Shafaq's residence. Gather initial clues and speak to Miss Shafaq.

phases.name: Exploring Connections
phases.objective: Visit Miss Kiran Shafaq's residence and investigate the Liverpool connections. Uncover the relationship between the victims and the suspect.

phases.name: Uncovering the Truth
phases.objective: Track down Sagar Ronit aboard the *May Day* and gather conclusive evidence. Piece together the timeline of events leading to the murders.

phases.name: Final Confrontation
phases.objective: Confront Sagar Ronit with the evidence and secure his confession. Ensure all loose ends are tied up and justice is served.

objects.name: Cardboard Box
objects.description: A small, yellow cardboard box wrapped in brown paper and tied with tarred twine. The box is stained with salt and has a faint smell of coffee.
objects.notes: The package sent to Miss Shafaq. Contains two human ears preserved in coarse salt. The box and its contents are the central focus of the investigation.

objects.name: Brown Paper Wrapper
objects.description: A piece of brown paper with a distinct smell of coffee. The address is printed in straggling characters: 'Miss Meenal. Shafaq, Cross Street, Croydon.'
objects.notes: The wrapper from the package. Contains clues about the sender, including the misspelled address and the masculine handwriting.

objects.name: Tarred Twine
objects.description: A piece of thick, tarred twine used to tie the package. The knot is a sailor's knot, and the twine smells faintly of the sea.

objects.name: Two Human Ears
objects.description: Two human ears, one male and one female, preserved in coarse salt. The male ear is pierced for an earring, and both ears show signs of having been freshly severed.
objects.notes: The gruesome contents of the package. The ears are evidence of a double murder and provide clues about the victims' identities and the killer's motives.

objects.notes: Used to preserve the ears in the package. The type of salt provides a clue about the killer's background and motives.
